name: 2D Texture-Based Advection with Volumetric Illumination
aliases: Dense texture-based visualization of unsteady 3D flow
definition: An interactive technique for dense texture-based visualization of unsteady 3D flow that achieves efficient 3D texture advection by mapping logical 3D memory to 2D physical memory using 2D textures.
summary: This method visualizes unsteady 3D flow by mapping logical 3D memory to physical 2D textures and using a volumetric importance function to reduce clutter and occlusion.
